cpu_reference_rule: Exact equality of every recorded comparison measurement and level row; production is not asserted bit-identical to native WRF.
field_hash_rule: Receipt got_sha256 and level hashes use defined_output_mask with SENTINEL for undefined optional horizontal words. Archive raw SHA256 includes every unmasked word. Production archives are compared in full as uint32.

prior_capture.scope: same H100 session and environment, every raw archive word of all five variants
